note: One row per species. null means this guide does not record the fact; it does not mean zero, absent or unknown to science. Lengths and wingspans are centimetres, mass is grams. population is the approximate Kruger estimate in the unit named. regions lists the parts of the park where the species is recorded, and regionsNote says where it is recorded most and on what count.

regions.label: Far north
regions.extent: North of the Shingwedzi River to the Limpopo River: Punda Maria, Pafuri and the Luvuvhu River.

regions.label: North
regions.extent: From the Olifants River north to the Shingwedzi River: Letaba, Mopani and Shingwedzi.

regions.label: Central
regions.extent: From the Sabie River north to the Olifants River: Satara, Orpen, Tshokwane and Olifants.

regions.label: South
regions.extent: From the Crocodile River north to the Sabie River, with Marloth Park: Skukuza, Lower Sabie, Pretoriuskop, Berg-en-Dal and Crocodile Bridge.
